verdict.rationale: Rive's docs say the editor lets you create vector graphics, and a community user confirms a pen tool exists. That same user calls the drawing toolset only 'pen and a couple of basic shapes', which undercuts the 'professional' claim. Missing for 10: documented pen/path-editing depth, boolean operations, precise alignment/snapping tools, and independent corroboration that the toolset suits real interface design work.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work

citations.quote: Create vector graphics, responsive layouts, and reusable components
